title: 3,670 security, medical personnel deployed for ASEAN defense meetings in Lapu-Lapu

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — A total of 3,670 security and medical personnel have been mobilized to ensure the safety and security of delegates, officials, and the public during the 20th ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and the 13th ADMM-Plus, which Lapu-Lapu City will host from October 26 to 30, 2026. The Philippine National Police (PNP) formally deployed the personnel during a send-off ceremony held on October 23 at the Liberty Shrine in Barangay Mactan, marking the operational readiness of the unified, multi-agency security contingent. The ceremony was organized by the Committee on Security, Peace and Order, and Emergency Preparedness and Response […]...
